args.summary: Built stdlib-only compress.py supporting both requested commands, with self-contained numeric-column and periodic-text modeling plus lossless compression and a generic fallback. The registered assay verifies byte-identical restoration and prints only percentage size reduction. Final repeated checks compressed corpus.txt from 313,972 to 3,441 bytes—a 98.904% reduction, versus 35,399 bytes for default zlib. Both CLI round-trip verification and six additional edge-case tests passed; improvements were evaluated through scored variants.
